body:
Addendum: fails with all JDK versions that support the --enable-preview flag (tested JDK11,13,14).
I chose JDK13 at random.
/cc @geoand I remember you made some changes in this area?
The change I had made was to make dev-mode preview aware (https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/8279). We probably need to do additional work to make it work everywhere
Should we try to target 1.5 for that one? We have quite a lot of people trying Java records.

DevMode launches a fresh jvm for compilation (DevMojo$DevModeRunner).
Would it be possible to re-run/fork for the build-mojo in a similar way?

Seems like surefire also does [something similar](https://github.com/apache/maven-surefire/blob/master/maven-surefire-common/src/main/java/org/apache/maven/plugin/surefire/booterclient/ForkStarter.java) to support custom runtime arguments for tests.
@HonoluluHenk unfortunately you need to manually set `MAVEN_OPTS="--enable-preview"` and / or `<argLine>${preview.arg}</argLine>` for Maven surefire

I tried attached example with Quarkus master `MAVEN_OPTS="--enable-preview"` way is the only one which works. @geoand did some improvements in propagating build arguments to quarkus maven plugin, but it's not enough for this issue.

maven-tooling guide update would be good to have, including some explanation why global opts need to be specified.

One thing to mention is that the Entity doesn't need to use experimental features at all.

It's enough that the project has "--enable-preview" settings in pom.xml and build fails with `[ERROR] 	[error]: Build step io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.HibernateOrmProcessor#pregenProxies threw an exception: java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: Preview features are not enabled for org/acme/FooEntity (class file version 57.65535). Try running with '--enable-preview'`
@rsvoboda yeah, we should probably document that `MAVEN_OPTS="--enable-preview"` is necessary when building (and why it's necessary).

The `MAVEN_OPTS` trick mentioned here seems to trigger another error: 

```
java.lang.RuntimeException: io.quarkus.bootstrap.BootstrapException: Failed to create the application model for null
```
